title: Restore links Transfer payees to same-named accounts of OTHER budgets (linkRestoredTransferPayees lacks a.budget_id scope)
notes: Found in the phase 5c/5d E2E (budget-ku4): in budgetnew_dev, Trabalho's 'Transfer : Poupança Nubank' and 'Transfer : Itau Conta Corrente' payees point at Casa's accounts, so creating a transfer to them answers 400 'transfer account not found in budget' (old API identical, pre-existing, same SQL as syscd). api/src/budget/store/restore.ts linkRestoredTransferPayees: UPDATE payees p SET transfer_account_id = a.id FROM accounts a WHERE p.budget_id = $1 AND p.name = 'Transfer : ' || a.name -- missing AND a.budget_id = $1 (and NOT a.deleted). Needs a fix + a data repair for rows already cross-linked.
